tools.name: atos_search
tools.description: Search and rank ATOS capabilities by natural-language intent and constraints.

tools.name: atos_get_capability
tools.description: Get full metadata and schemas for one capability.

tools.name: atos_quote
tools.description: Create a time-limited executable commercial quote for a capability.

tools.name: atos_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a bounded capability using an executable quote.

tools.name: atos_create_job
tools.description: Create a long-running or interactive ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_get_job
tools.description: Get the current state, messages and artifacts of an ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a non-terminal ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_register_capability
tools.description: Register a provider capability on ATOS.

tools.name: atos_update_capability
tools.description: Update mutable metadata/configuration of a capability owned by the authenticated provider.

tools.name: atos_account
tools.description: Get account balance, usage and autonomous spending policy.

tools.name: atos_artifact
tools._comment: One tool, not three -- create_upload/complete_upload/get_download_url are one intent ('work with an artifact'), not three. Always visible, not gated (see docs/MCP.md 'Per-Caller Tool Visibility'): any caller might need file I/O for any capability with a file-typed field, so there's no reliable per-caller signal to gate this on. A server validates operation-specific required fields itself.
tools.description: Work with ATOS artifacts (binary content): create_upload requests a signed upload target, complete_upload finalizes one into a reusable artifact_id, get_download_url returns a signed download link. Bytes never travel through this call itself, only through the signed URL it returns.

conditionally_visible_tools._comment: Unlike the tools array above, these are genuinely gated -- a server MUST compute tools/list per request and include these only for a principal that actually owns at least one capability (see docs/MCP.md 'Per-Caller Tool Visibility' and 'Provider/Admin Tools'). Listing them here unconditionally, as an earlier revision of this schema did under a separate 'optional_tools' key, does not itself make them discoverable; the gating logic lives in the server, not in this static file.

provider_admin.name: atos_list_my_capabilities
provider_admin.description: List capabilities owned by the authenticated provider.

provider_admin.name: atos_pause_capability
provider_admin.description: Pause one of the authenticated provider's own capabilities so it stops matching new searches.
